page_title: ESP 2-1 VLL | Espanyol v Valladolid 17/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Kike Perez (Valladolid) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
90+4' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Marcos Andre (Valladolid) sends a wild header high over the bar.
90+4' Now Valladolid have a corner.
90+4' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Brian Olivan (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Ricardo De Burgos didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) picks up a precise pass and attempts to threaten the keeper with a long-range effort, but it goes well wide of the mark.
87' The current number of shots on goal is 4:4.
83' Brian Olivan (Espanyol) takes the direct free kick from the edge of the box, but his shot flies wide of the target.
82' The substitution has been made. Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) has replaced Stanko Juric.
81' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Selim Amallah (Valladolid) for his blatant foul.
81' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Espanyol.
80' Substitution. Fernando Calero (Espanyol) in, Alejo Veliz out.
77' The possession of the ball – 39:61.
76' Mario Martin (Valladolid) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top left corner, but Joan Garcia has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

74' 2 - 1 Goal! Omar El Hilali hands Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the middle of the goal. 2:1.
73' Alex Kral (Espanyol) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo De Burgos no option but to blow his whistle.
72' Jofre (Espanyol) serves up a nice cross, but Karl Hein punches the ball away.
72' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Exposito (Espanyol) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar.
69' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
67' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) makes a slide tackle, but referee Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul.
63' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Alvaro Tejero is replaced by Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Exposito (Espanyol) replaces Pol Lozano.
63' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
63' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
62' The free kick from long range, taken by Espanyol, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
61' Dangerous play by Javier Sanchez (Valladolid). Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.
60' The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.
58' Substitution. Antoniu Roca makes way for Jofre (Espanyol).
57' 1 - 1 Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) scores a beautiful goal from the resulting free kick. He bends the ball into the top left corner. A technically stunning goal.
57' Diego Cocca is forced to make a change. Raul Moro (Valladolid) is unable to continue due to injury, Selim Amallah comes on.
54' It doesn’t look good for Raul Moro (Valladolid); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
53' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Valladolid have a free kick from a promising distance.
52' Valladolid fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.
52' Valladolid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
51' The ball is cleared after Raul Moro (Valladolid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Valladolid.
50' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Karl Hein to dive and make a save.
49' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Espanyol win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
49' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Ricardo De Burgos signals.
47' The attendance is 23554.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valladolid.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo De Burgos had an easy-decision to make.
45' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
43' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' One of the players from Espanyol times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
41' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
40' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' 3:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
35' Rough tackle by Alex Kral (Espanyol). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 3:7.
34' Valladolid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

31' 1 - 0 Javi Puado (Espanyol) meets a perfect cross from Alvaro Tejero on the edge of the penalty area and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike straight into the bottom right corner. It's 1:0.
30' A clumsy foul by Stanko Juric (Valladolid) and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle.
30' A lofted cross from Raul Moro (Valladolid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
26' Javi Puado (Espanyol) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
26' Kike Perez (Valladolid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
23' What a chance that is! Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
23' The referee blows his whistle as Abdulay Juma Bah (Valladolid) was too aggressive in his challenge.
20' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 47:53.
19' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) commits a rough foul. Ricardo De Burgos stops the game and makes a call.
17' Valladolid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

17' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save! Valladolid get a corner.
15' The game is interrupted. Stanko Juric (Valladolid) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
14' Raul Moro (Valladolid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
12' Raul Moro (Valladolid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) tries to find Antoniu Roca, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
10' Javi Puado (Espanyol) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Karl Hein comes off his line to intercept.
9' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) sends a long ball in, but Joan Garcia comfortably gathers the ball.
7' CHANCE! Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
7' Espanyol earn a corner.
7' Brian Olivan (Espanyol) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
4' Ricardo De Burgos blows the whistle, Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) is penalised for a foul.
3' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Valladolid will kick the game off.
Ricardo De Burgos was nominated as the referee for this game.
